title: Governed policy phase closeout and T026 migration readiness

phases.objective: Prove the PR #4181 post-merge/T026 migration-design readiness path and the repository-side T030 OAuth correlation runtime wiring without granting migration apply, Activation-run synthesis, Recovery OAuth source authority, or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: PR #4181 closeout evidence and the two governed-policy SQL design files
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reviewer receives deterministic checksums, statement counts, additive schema validation, and explicit no-authorization evidence while unsafe SQL or incomplete closeout evidence fails closed.
steps: Load and validate the exact PR #4181 post-merge closeout evidence and completed task set.
Read both governed-policy SQL design files and run the canonical static migration preflight.
Verify expected additive tables, activation ordering, and the absence of destructive SQL, active seed DML, or embedded authorization.
Return ready-for-governed-preflight evidence while keeping Apply, ledger writes, runtime wiring, and Production mutation disabled.
assertions: The closeout binds PR #4181 to its validated head and merge SHA with zero unresolved review threads.
Both migration designs produce bounded SHA-256 checksums and positive statement counts.
Missing tables, unsafe ordering, destructive SQL, active governed-policy seed DML, or embedded authorization blocks readiness.
Ready for governed preflight never implies migration authorization or SQL Apply.
The journey performs no database write, migration-ledger write, runtime wiring, deployment, provider call, credential read, external send, or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Tenant GPT OAuth authorize → code → token → protected-resource gateway repository runtime
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository carries one server-owned OAuth correlation through gateway_verify, binds the authorization-code row to operation_id, preserves replay/tamper/drift rejection, and still leaves T030 open until governed migration apply/readback, exact-SHA Staging verification, and a legitimate Activation-run projection bridge.
steps: Verify authorize creates the correlation server-side and exposes only a short-lived signed ticket bound to client, resource, redirect URI and OAuth state.
Verify /oauth/code validates the ticket, advances identity_verify, persists request_correlation_ref = operation_id, then signs oauth_code_issue correlation into the authorization-code JWT.
Verify /oauth/token consumes the exact code row with the same operation_id before issuing a token-exchange correlation bound to the access JTI.
Verify protected-resource authentication rejects invalid correlation claims and advances only verified claims to gateway_verify in server-owned req.auth context.
Verify no synthetic activation_run, parallel ledger, Recovery OAuth source branding, callback_received claim, receipt signing, migration apply, deployment or Production mutation occurs.
assertions: T030 remains unchecked until governed migration apply/readback and exact-SHA Staging verification complete.
request_correlation_ref is the OAuth correlation operation_id and has no foreign key to activation_runs.
activation_operation_projections.operation_id remains owned by activation_runs.run_id; this PR does not bridge pre-Activation OAuth identity by manufacturing a run.
Caller tampering, cross-code/client/resource/subject/access-JTI drift and code replay fail closed.
callback_received remains unresolved, oauth_server_correlation_source_available remains false, and receipt_signed remains false.

phases.objective: Authorize and apply the two T026 migrations through the governed runner, then prove migration-ledger and schema readback before any runtime wiring.
blockers: Exact deployed-candidate environment preflight has not been completed.
Fresh checksum-bound migration authorization and exact typed confirmation do not exist.
Same-cycle dry-run, governed single Apply, migration-ledger readback, and schema readback remain incomplete.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Exact deployed candidate plus fresh checksum-bound migration authorization
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Both additive migrations are applied once through the governed runner and verified through exact ledger and schema readback before runtime wiring is considered.
steps: Run environment and schema-collision preflight against the exact deployed candidate.
Create fresh checksum-bound authorization and require exact typed confirmation.
Run the same-cycle dry-run and one governed Apply.
Read back the migration ledger and every expected table, index, constraint, and ordering boundary.

phases.objective: Prove idempotent retry, partial-failure classification, rollback boundaries, and recovery from unknown migration outcomes without duplicate Apply.
Validate the applied governed-policy schema and disabled-by-default runtime integration against an authorized live non-production target.
Verify exact Production SHA, migration ledger, schema parity, runtime readback, monitoring, and rollback under separate release authorization.
